title: Resolution urging Albany to fund IVF with a tax credit
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.5262/A.3051, creating a refundable tax credit for up to three cycles of in vitro fertilization not covered by insurance. It cites IVF costs ranging from $15,000 to $30,000 per cycle and notes state insurance mandates do not cover small-group, individual or exchange plans. The measure aims to ease financial burdens on New Yorkers pursuing fertility treatment.
